name: PyMC Bot
description: The PyMC Bot companion mod: records your Minecraft playtime (position, look direction, block neighbourhood, nearby entities and the keys you pressed) into a dataset that PyMC Bot trains a player model on. Open the PyMC Bot settings page with /pymcbot settings, the hotkey or Mod Menu's Configure button. One jar per Minecraft version, 1.21.1 to 26.3. Made with ❤️ by codero-sus.
